example_more_specific.what: 成员页正文为空；示例显示它是按 0..Count-1 索引的取值器，与同索引的 Entity(i) 一一对应。
example_more_specific.example_quote:
For i = 0 To nCount - 1
        Set swEnt = swFaultEnt.Entity(i)
        If Not swEnt Is Nothing Then
            bRet = swEnt.Select4(True, Nothing): Debug.Assert bRet
        End If
        Debug.Print " Fault[" & i & "] = " & swFaultEnt.ErrorCode(i)
    Next i

results.note: 四个例子都经 FaultEntity 取值，确属同一接口，未撞名。
